doctrine: Original handwritten bore logs are the canonical PARENT truth. Split rows are children/siblings/segments grouped under their parent. A child entry may be placed/rendered ONLY through its parent group, which must disambiguate ownership (span + sheets) so a child cannot claim a sibling's route (the log48<-log50 failure). Additive grouping layer over the existing 58-child ingestion -- census frozen; corpus + loader unchanged.
